notes.title: Easy Sketch Version 3.0
notes.content:
Enhanced Brushes
Pressure, smoothness and transparency based brush with
full sensitivity control."Hook" brush for creating guided strokes easily and intuitively.
https://youtu.be/KvsCD9cNVBc


Anatomically Accurate Models
2 new anatomically accurate models added with color groups for sets of muscles.
Pose the new male and female models with dozens of inbuilt poses and accurate deformations and proportions
https://youtu.be/5IIpiLk8DbU

Improved Memory Management
Optimized all app operations wrt memory, texture size and thumbnails

notes.title: VERSION 2.0
notes.content:
Easy Sketch Pose Ver 2.0 New Features:

1.Layer functionality:HSV and Opacity
2.Pose library:Save,load and export
3.FBX import w/ animation
4.Dynamic lighting
5.Smooth brush line
6.Windowed Mode
7.Crowd objects for faster city population
8.Dynamic controllers for easy posing
9.Extensive pose library for all characters 
[previewyoutube=5KnJ2cRCYyE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
